scope: Mainline QDSP6 (APR, q6core, q6afe, q6asm, q6adm, q6routing) on the MSM8226 ADSP: audio probe kernel (fx0-linux integration/fx0-audio 68ac6144c11a, r13 config + QCOM_APR, SND_SOC_QCOM, SND_SOC_QDSP6, SLIMbus, WCD9306) RAM-booted with the installed initramfs
dt: qcom-msm8226.dtsi APR node: q6core service@3, q6afe service@4 with q6afedai, q6asm service@7 with q6asmdai (no IOMMU), q6adm service@8 with q6routing
result: all four APR services bind (qcom-q6core, qcom-q6afe, qcom-q6asm, qcom-q6adm); ASoC registers the q6afe DAI component (137 DAIs including SLIMBUS_0_RX) and q6routing. q6asm-dai failed only on load order (needs q6routing symbols loaded first).
config_note: SND_SOC_QCOM must be enabled for QDSP6; SND_SOC_COMPRESS and SND_SOC_TOPOLOGY become built-in, so QDSP6 needs a kernel package, not just modules
